weather_email.script:
trigger = Cron(mode='cron', cronExpression='0 6 * * *')
fetch_weather = HttpRequest(method='GET', url='https://api.weather.example.com/current')
check_empty = If(operation='isEmpty')
error_node = StopAndError(errorType='error', message='Weather API response was empty.')
send_email = SendEmail(
    toEmail='ops@example.com',
    subject='Daily weather check',
    body='The daily weather check completed successfully.',
    bodyFormat='plain'
)

trigger >> fetch_weather
fetch_weather >> check_empty
check_empty.true >> error_node
check_empty.false >> send_email

validate()
